description: This file implements utility functions for the BML (Beerock Management Layer) which convert various data structures related to network nodes, statistics, and events into string representations for logging or display purposes.

methods.name: std::string node_type_to_string(uint8_t type)
methods.description: Converts a node type value to its string representation.

methods.name: std::string node_state_to_string(uint8_t state)
methods.description: Converts a node state value to its string representation.

methods.name: std::string radio_vendor_to_string(uint8_t vendor)
methods.description: Converts radio vendor IDs to their string names.

methods.name: int bml_utils_node_to_string(const struct BML_NODE * node,char * buffer,int buffer_len)
methods.description: Creates a detailed string describing a network node's properties.

methods.name: int bml_utils_stats_to_string(const struct BML_STATS * stats,char * buffer,int buffer_len)
methods.description: Creates a string with summarized network statistics for a given stats structure.

methods.name: int bml_utils_stats_to_string_raw(const struct BML_STATS * stats,char * buffer,int buffer_len)
methods.description: Creates a raw string representation of network statistics.

methods.name: int bml_utils_event_to_string(const struct BML_EVENT * event,char * buffer,int buffer_len)
methods.description: Creates a string description of various network events based on event type.

ctags.name: bml_utils_event_to_string
